statement.notes: Only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was requested for extraction. The value was directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the operating activities section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. All other fields from the schema were omitted as they were not requested. The supplementary tables contain detailed breakdowns for operating leases and parent company cash flows, but these were not required for the specified field.
